prompt: A good friend is regularly 30 minutes late when you meet, leaving you waiting and feeling your time does not matter. What response best addresses it without starting a fight?

options.text: Start arriving 30 minutes late yourself to teach them how it feels
Pick a calm moment, say how the waiting affects you, and agree a clear plan together, such as a start time and what happens if someone is held up
Stop replying to them and let the friendship end without any explanation
Complain to mutual friends and hope the message gets back to them

explanation: Naming the pattern calmly and agreeing a practical plan tackles the behaviour without attacking the person. Revenge lateness, silent withdrawal, and complaining through others never give your friend a fair chance to change.
